method.extension_check: for each main-variable assignment, decide auxiliary satisfiability (a) by an independent unit-propagation+DPLL implemented in this script and (b) by Cadical195 with the main variables fixed as assumptions; a case counts as a mismatch only when both agree against the ground truth
method.ground_truth: single-set variants: exactly k of the n main literals true; joint variant: #BOTH == c and #NONE == e
method.joint_variant: 4^n assignments per (n,c,e) for the chained equals(BOTH,c)/equals(NONE,e) pair of build()

scope_note: per-case range is stated in records; joint capped at n<=joint_nmax
